blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The National Transmission Corporation (TransCo) is stepping up efforts to reduce the duration of power outages in Oriental and Occidental Mindoro, through better grid monitoring and closer coordination with power generators and distribution utilities. Currently, consumers served by the Oriental Mindoro Electric Cooperative (ORMECO) experience two to three power interruptions every month, with blackouts typically lasting one to four hours — a situation that has affected households, businesses, and essential services across the province. TransCo Public Relations Officer Aristides Espano explained in a Monda video post that power supply interruptions across the island stem from multiple […]...
